Farah Khan responds to Cyrus Broacha's comments about her cook

Filmmaker-choreographer Farah Khan responded to comments made by Cyrus Broacha, who had called her cook, Dilip, a "fraud and overrated." Khan offered Broacha Dilip's position, in what was described as a "savage reply."
